name: Shenye Lamian
source:
"Midnight Ramen" is a narrative dialogue game inspired by titles such as VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action and Coffee Talk, in which players take on the role of a ramen stall owner, who operates a stand that only opens late at night, as well as his apprentice Homura. Together they work to run their stand, feed their customers, and help them solve their problems.

[Edited from [url=https://cointinuegames.itch.io/midnight-ramen-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《午夜拉面》是一款叙事对话游戏，灵感源自《VA-11 Hall-A：赛博朋克调酒师动作》和《咖啡谈话》等游戏，玩家在游戏中扮演拉面摊主，经营一个只在深夜营业的摊位，以及他的学徒小焰。他们共同努力经营自己的摊位，为顾客提供食物，并帮助他们解决问题。

[编辑自[url=https://cointinuegames.itch.io/midnight-ramen-demo]itch.io[/url]]
